faithful_paraphrase: The current Polish Air is the fanless M5 generation in 13- and 15-inch sizes, positioned from 6,499 PLN in the current Mac store listing.
The current Pro offers M5, M5 Pro and M5 Max configurations, more memory/storage headroom and starts at 8,499 PLN for 14-inch; M5 Pro purchase listings start higher.
The Air completed the reviewer's 4K-to-1080p Handbrake workload in 4:41, showing capable short-form transcoding but not eliminating sustained thermal limits.

In sustained raw-video Adobe Premiere testing, the Air produced 52% of the Pro's score despite much closer short benchmark results, indicating the practical effect of active cooling and higher-tier silicon.
